Taxes Committee
Wednesday, May Ist, 2024
08:30 AM, G-15 Capitol

Minutes
ent

Present: Senator Ann H. Rest - Chair, Senator Matt D. Klein - Vice Chair, Senator Bill

Weber, Senator D. Scott Dibble, Senator Steve Drazkowski, Senator Kari Dziedzic, Senator
Grant Hauschild, Senator Jeremy R. Miller, Senator Carla J. Nelson, Senator Aric Putnam

Absent: No Members Absent

Senator Ann H. Rest called the meeting to order at 8:33 a.m.

Approval of the minutes from 4/25/24.

The minutes were approved as presented.

Senator Matt D. Klein moved to take S.F. 5234 off the table. MOTION PREVAILED.
S.F. 5234: Senator Rest: Omnibus Tax Bill.

Senator Klein moved the A-2 amendment. The motion prevailed and the amendment was
adopted.

Testifiers:

Casey Muhm, SCRFA Fiscal Analyst

Eric Silvia, SCRFA Senate Counsel

Nora Pollock, SCRFA Senate Counsel

Rachel Johnson, SCRFA Legislative Analyst

Paul Marquart, Commissioner, Department of Revenue

John Johnson, Itasca Country Commissioner, Chair of County Board

Natletha Sumo Kollie, Justice Manager, Children’s Defense Fund Minnesota

Nan Madden, Director, Minnesota Budget Project

Nathan Jesson, League of Minnesota Cities

Ania McDonnell, Metro Cities

Matt Massman, Minnesota Inter-County Association

Beth Kadoun, Vice President, Tax and Fiscal Policy, Minnesota Chamber of Commerce
Gavin Hanson, Fiscal and Economic Policy Director, Minnesota Business Partnership
Grace Waltz, Vice President of Public Policy, Minneapolis Chamber of Commerce
Shelia Vanney, Associate Director, Minnesota Association of Soil and Water Conservation
Districts

Emily Myatt, Government Relations Director, American Cancer Society

Senator Ann H. Rest moved that S.F. 5234, as amended, be laid over.
